How evidence is classified
Main goalThe desired end result, such as finding a missing pet.
BehaviourAn observable action, such as posting on Facebook or calling a vet.
MotivationAn explicitly stated reason or driver for acting.
ConstraintA circumstance that limits action, such as time, transport or permission.
Pain pointExperienced friction, confusion, repetition, delay or uncertainty.
NeedInformation, guidance, coordination or capability that would help progress.

Reanalyse all research?

Original research will not be changed.

The current observations, patterns, proposals, connections and gaps will be copied to an audit archive. Every source will then be analysed again using the current classification rules.

Existing personas will be kept, but their old evidence links will be removed and their status changed to Unvalidated until you approve and apply the new patterns.
